answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a stake that is slashed on fraud, like an onyx seal costly to forge: spawning a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand stakes, so the attacker's cost grows linearly while honest agents keep just one. Reputation that accrues slowly, like a glacier moving, pushes the horizon for profitable fakery further away, since fakes pay upfront and earn nothing before detection.
